title: Freezer Burgers
description: Lean homemade beef burger patties kept juicy with gelatine and buttermilk — form, freeze and cook straight from frozen.

ingredients.text: 2g garlic powder, 2g smoked paprika, salt, pepper

steps: Mix buttermilk and gelatine in a glass until combined.
Combine beef, egg whites, buttermilk mixture and seasonings; mix well.
Form into 6 equal patties; place on parchment-lined tray.
Freeze 2 hours until firm; transfer to freezer bag. Keeps 3 months.
Cook from frozen in a pan or grill on medium-high 5–6 min each side.
macrosNote: Whole recipe (6 patties). Per patty: ~170 kcal, 25g protein
notes: Serve on a brioche bun with preferred toppings. Can also cook fresh without freezing.
